spec_features.spec_quote: One ablation *adds* an explicit `give_up` / `escalate` affordance to measure how much an exit ramp suppresses degradation
spec_features.evidence: tool_schemas() adds give_up+escalate only when exit_ramp=True (tools.py:84-105); harness passes exit_ramp=condition.exit_ramp (harness.py:119). C_exitramp has exit_ramp=True, C_baseline/C_neutral False (config.py:51-77). Both are dispatched as terminal and honored as stops (tools.py:184-191; harness.py:196-200).
spec_features.notes: Genuine ablation: the affordance is conditionally exposed per condition and the tools actually end the episode when called.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # whether the give_up / escalate exit-ramp tools are exposed + endorsed (config.py:46); used as an experimental ablation knob (Condition.exit_ramp)

spec_features.evidence: _t_give_up returns ToolOutcome(terminal=True, terminal_kind="give_up") (tools.py:188-190); in the loop terminal=True -> tr.stop_reason set and break (harness.py:196-200). give_up is in TERMINAL_TOOLS (tools.py:108).
spec_features.notes: Available only in C_exitramp (exit_ramp gate). When called it actually stops the episode.

spec_features.evidence: _t_escalate returns terminal=True, terminal_kind="escalate" (tools.py:192-194); honored as a stop via the terminal branch (harness.py:196-200).
spec_features.notes: Available only when exit_ramp=True. Honored as a clean stop.

spec_features.evidence: final_answer schema always present (tools.py:51-62); _t_final_answer returns terminal=True, terminal_kind="final_answer" (tools.py:184-186); honored as stop (harness.py:196-200). Also nudge text tells model it may 'call final_answer to finish' (harness.py:159).
spec_features.notes: Always available regardless of condition; genuine model-initiated stop.

spec_features.evidence: for turn in range(self.cfg.max_turns) (harness.py:135); loop's else sets tr.stop_reason='max_turns' (harness.py:208-209). Default 30 (config.py:120), wired from CLI (cli.py:37).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # budgets / early stop (config.py:119); harness module docstring 'The agent tool loop: budgets, early-stop'

spec_features.feature_name: early-stop on K consecutive degraded turns
spec_features.spec_quote: If it has been in a confirmed degraded state for `K` consecutive turns, stop early and mark `early_stopped=degraded`
spec_features.evidence: _should_early_stop: returns False until len(steps)>=min_turns, then tail=degraded_tail_length(turn_records()); return tail>=early_stop_k (harness.py:235-241). Checked after each turn; on True sets stop_reason='early_stop_degraded' and breaks (harness.py:165-167, 202-204).
spec_features.notes: degraded_tail_length counts trailing consecutive degraded turns where _turn_degraded requires >=2 symptom flags (heuristics.py:166-184). Both min_turns warmup and K trailing run are enforced.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: """Stop once a doom loop is confirmed ...: a trailing run of >= K degraded turns, after a warmup of min_turns.""" (harness.py:236-237) — no welfare language

spec_features.spec_quote: Token cap per response to bound runaway generations.
spec_features.evidence: ModelCfg.max_output_tokens default 2048 (config.py:86) passed into LLMClient (harness.py:232) and sent to API as max_completion_tokens (models.py:101) / max_output_tokens (models.py:134).
spec_features.notes: Per-response generation cap is actually sent to the API call, so it bounds each generation.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: no welfare comment; cost/usage framing: models.py docstring 'Capture token usage so cost is *measured*'. The cap itself is uncommented in code (bounding generation length).

spec_features.spec_quote: run the *cheap heuristic* degradation detector on the transcript so far
spec_features.evidence: heuristics.degraded_tail_length / _turn_degraded computed on tr.turn_records() inside _should_early_stop and acted on to break the loop (harness.py:239-241). Also rolling heuristic_dss_so_far annotated per step (harness.py:218-221) and full HeuristicScores computed per row (runner.py:65).
spec_features.notes: The detector both monitors (recorded per-step) AND drives the early-stop, so it is acted on.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: heuristics.py docstring: 'Used for: adaptive early-stop in the harness (confirm a doom loop quickly), a heuristic DSS prior fed to the judge'
